welcome-fallback.speaker: pip
welcome-fallback.text: Oh! It's you. Tell us what tonight's story is about, or hand us something from the drawer.

finder-picks.speaker: moth
finder-picks.text: This one's been rattling all night!

slow.speaker: narrator
slow.text: The lamp flickers… now, where were we?

offline.speaker: narrator
offline.text: The lamp has gone quiet. The story will wait right here.

redirect-a.speaker: narrator
redirect-a.text: And just then, the page turned all by itself, to somewhere cozier.

redirect-b.speaker: narrator
redirect-b.text: A gentle wind turned the page, and the story found a kinder path.

finder-empty.speaker: moth
finder-empty.text: Couldn't find it anywhere! Maybe it's still lost.

finder-tired.speaker: moth
finder-tired.text: My wings are tired, but your satchel's full of treasures.

resting.speaker: narrator
resting.text: That's all the story the lamp has oil for tonight.

close-fallback.speaker: narrator
close-fallback.text: And so the story was gathered up, and tucked into the book for another night.

close-time.speaker: narrator
close-time.text: The lamp burns low, and tonight's story comes to rest.

ears-down.speaker: pip
ears-down.text: I couldn't hear you just then. Show me instead?
